scope: Versioned offline forehead-skin extension of four existing real generated targets; full37 registration and paired current-viewer quality diagnostics

cohort.upstream_failures: Retain the historical four failed fits as upstream failures, not successful registered targets or silently omitted requests

annotations.image_observation: All four native1024 targets were viewed before new candidate pixels, atlases, renders or scores. Prior results and support deficits were already known; this is development, not blind evaluation
annotations.skin: Explicit per-target interior forehead polygons bounded away from hair, eyebrows, lenses and frame; no release of lens-visible eyes or uncertain surfaces
annotations.protection: Inherit the exact per-target protected lens/frame/bridge polygons from the previous frozen annotation package and retain the twelve-native-pixel square margin
annotations.coordinates: Integer native target-image pixels, origin upper-left; each target has its own observed polygons and image/fit pins
annotations.rasterization: OpenCV LINE_8 shift0, each simple polygon filled separately then unioned; deliberately retain the prior offline candidate raster rule rather than claim the interactive editor pixel-center rule
annotations.bounds: At most64 polygons per category, 3..128 integer vertices each, at most4096 total; reject nonfinite, noninteger, out-of-range, duplicate, degenerate, self-intersecting or touching nonadjacent edges

composition.extension: Unlike the previous candidate, explicit visible forehead skin need not be inside the old0..26-landmark convex hull or oldB uncertainty band
composition.invariants: Original allowed pixels remain allowed; new additions must lie inside the observed polygons and outside protected margin. Both masks stay binary/disjoint; all unmarked pixels remain unchanged
composition.forbidden: No source color fallback, inferred skin behind glasses, eye release, mirrored texture, inpainting, geometric/projection/UV changes, or automatic all-allowed mask
composition.other33: Inherit the complete other33 review objects unchanged; do not relabel them as newly reviewed

freezing.inputs: Closed hash-pinned metadata, focus PNG/fit/old-mask inputs, exact imported implementation/test sources and selected runtime; no recursive hidden asset reads
freezing.file_bounds: Bound metadata and binaries before allocation; read at most declared length plus one byte and recheck before atomic publication
freezing.publication: Fresh ignored output directories; preserve original masks, all prior plans, results and failures; four candidate mask sets and a new full37 review only after all inputs validate
freezing.live_stage: These existing offline targets have no current live stage. Do not fabricate stage_id or claim an API session registration

registration.implementation: Reuse unchanged target_uv_probe.py with a separately pinned variant protocol and full37 review
registration.coordinates: Each target's own full fit/projection/ROI and original fixed source canonical geometry; common topology-bound UV and ordered indices unchanged
registration.comparison: Compare against conservative registration as primary and retain originalN4 as historical structural reference; four focus changes may only be target-mask-rejected class5 to sampled class6. All prior sampled RGBA and other33 assets/classifications remain exact
registration.unknown: Unsampled RGBA exactly zero; no color fill or cross-unknown interpolation
registration.roundtrip: Full37 offline checks plus actual Chrome/Edge export and reimport with fixed geometry/UV/RGBA/material checks

quality.renderer_drift: Current viewer source differs from20261024. Recapture conservative and new variants under the same current frozen viewer/browser/build, rather than compare new masks only to old archived PNGs
quality.matrix: Each variant has10 original sources plus37 targets, eight unchanged MASK/BLEND x front/90-degree-side x black/white configurations:376 frames and296 target-source pairs; total752 capture requests. Repeated original80 frames are controls, not new independent subjects
quality.visual: AI review of all four focus eight-configuration comparisons, side completeness, lens protection, unknown boundaries and seams; preserve failures and do not represent AI observation as human signoff
quality.identity_age: Redetect all376 frames per variant with fixed YuNet/SFace. MiVOLO uses only that variant's new identity detections/status. Retain all NO_FACE and other failures, requested/scored/failed denominators and effective source counts
quality.comparison: Report effective-set entries/exits and compare paired deltas only on common valid pairs/sources. Keep same-age generator drift separate from cross-age conditions and true age error
quality.thresholds: Identity quality_threshold remains null; original-photo-domain reference0.30832315136297866 is not a sparse-render acceptance threshold. Generated conditions are not age truth
quality.statistics: Reuse frozen identity/age aggregation and source-cluster bootstrap policies; intervals and quality decisions remain separate
quality.acceptance: Engineering registration success does not imply texture completeness, causal explanation of detector failure, calibrated years, identity preservation, human quality approval or G3
